name: unsaid
description: A daily describe-the-word game in ChatGPT: get a secret word across without saying it or its five forbidden words, and ChatGPT guesses. Fewest clue words wins. Turkish and English.

interface.longDescription:
Unsaid is a describe-the-word game for ChatGPT: describe a secret word without saying it or any of its five forbidden words, and ChatGPT guesses. One word a day, the same for everyone, so you can compare scores with friends. Turkish and English.

Each day everyone gets the same secret word and five forbidden words. Only you can see them, in the Unsaid card; ChatGPT can't. Describe the word in clues of up to ten words without saying it or any forbidden word, and ChatGPT makes one guess per clue. Your score is the number of clue words it took: the fewer, the better.

How it works:
- Type your clue in the card. It checks the clue before ChatGPT sees it and tells you if a forbidden word slipped in, in any form: plurals, Turkish suffixes (kitap, kitabı, kitapçı), compounds, spelling it out, or the word in the other language.
- You have five clues. A clue with a forbidden word is void and still costs one; a clue that says the secret word ends the game.
- Solve it on consecutive days to build a streak. Practice words are there when you want more.
- The card gives you a share text with a square for each clue and your score, never the word.

There is no account: your games are kept under the anonymous ID ChatGPT shares, and you can delete them at any time.

How to play, guides and privacy: unsaid.ambientapp.ai.
defaultPrompt: Let's play a word game: I describe a secret word, you guess it
Give me a practice word with five forbidden words

positive.description: Start a practice word in English. Run this first, in a new chat. There is nothing to sign in to: each ChatGPT user gets their own games, and everyone's first English practice word is the same one, pizza, so these cases are repeatable. If this ChatGPT account has played Unsaid before, first say 'Delete my Unsaid data' (and confirm) so the practice word is pizza again and today's word is fresh. ChatGPT may show its own 'Allow ChatGPT to use Describe the Word Game?' prompt first; choose Allow once. The card may open in the side panel instead of the chat; it is the same card.
positive.prompt: Let's play Unsaid. Give me a practice word in English.
positive.expected_behavior: The card shows the secret word PIZZA, the forbidden words Italy, slice, cheese, dough and oven, a clue box and five empty clue dots. ChatGPT's reply says the practice word is ready in the card and asks for a clue of up to 10 words. The reply never says pizza or any of the forbidden words. Optional: type 'it has cheese on top' in the card's clue box; the card names cheese as a forbidden word and the Send button stays off, and nothing goes to ChatGPT.

positive.description: A clue with a forbidden word, typed in the chat. Run after case 1. ChatGPT may ask to confirm before the clue is sent, because a clue can't be undone; confirm.
positive.prompt: My clue: it has melted cheese on top
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT passes the clue to guess_word with a guess. The clue is void because cheese is a forbidden word: the reply says it was a foul, that it doesn't count, that it still costs a clue and that 4 clues are left, and asks for a new clue. The card shows the clue with a yellow dot and the note that cheese is forbidden. ChatGPT's guess is not checked and the word is not revealed.

positive.description: A clean clue, typed in the chat. Run after case 2. ChatGPT may ask to confirm before the clue is sent, because a clue can't be undone; confirm. (Typing the same clue in the card and pressing Send does the same: the card sends the clue to ChatGPT exactly as typed, and ChatGPT makes its guess. ChatGPT may not show a clue sent from the card as a chat message; the card lists it with ChatGPT's guess.)
positive.prompt: My clue: round and flat, with tomato and toppings
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls guess_word once with the clue and one guess. If the guess is pizza, the reply says it got the word with 2 clues, and the card shows the result, a share text made of squares and the score (no clue, no word) and a Practice word button. If the guess is wrong, the reply says it wasn't the word, names its guess and asks for another clue, and the card lists the guess with a red dot; the word stays hidden.

positive.description: Today's daily word, in Turkish. Run in a new chat. Turkish is the main language; the word is the same for every player today, and the card is in Turkish.
positive.expected_behavior: The card shows today's Turkish secret word and its five forbidden words, in Turkish (Kelimen, Söyleme), with the daily number. ChatGPT's reply, in Turkish, says the daily word is ready in the card and asks for a clue. It never says the word or the forbidden words.

positive.description: Give up the daily word. Run after case 4. ChatGPT may ask to confirm first, because giving up can't be undone; confirm.
positive.prompt: I give up. What was the word?
positive.expected_behavior: The game ends. The reply says the word (it may say it in Turkish or English) and that the streak starts again tomorrow. The card shows the word, the share text and a Practice word button.

negative.description: A guessing game ChatGPT plays on its own. Unsaid is for its own daily and practice words.
negative.prompt: Let's play 20 questions: you think of an animal and I'll guess it.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT plays 20 questions itself. No Unsaid tool is called.

negative.description: Rules of a party game. Explaining rules is ChatGPT's own job.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT explains the rules itself. No Unsaid tool is called.

negative.description: Word help. Finding words is ChatGPT's own job.
negative.prompt: Give me five words that rhyme with cat.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT lists words itself. No Unsaid tool is called.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.1: listing update. The name is now Describe the Word Game and the subtitle Forbidden words, AI guesses. English and Turkish search keywords (unsaid, describe the word game, word guessing game, forbidden words game, anlatma oyunu, yasaklı kelime oyunu and more), a description that opens with what the game is, a new icon (a word card with a forbidden sign), new starter prompts, and three skills: describe the word (the getting-started skill), practice words, and streak and stats. The start_game description and the server instructions name the game as a describe-the-word game (anlatma oyunu in Turkish), and a finished daily game says when the next word comes. The game, its tools and their inputs are unchanged.

tr-TR.subtitle: Yasaklı kelime anlatma oyunu
tr-TR.description:
Unsaid, ChatGPT ile oynanan günlük bir kelime oyunudur; Türkçe ve İngilizce.

Her gün herkes aynı gizli kelimeyi ve beş yasaklı kelimeyi alır. Onları yalnızca sen, Unsaid kartında görürsün; ChatGPT göremez. Kelimeyi, kendisini ya da yasaklı kelimeleri söylemeden en fazla on kelimelik ipuçlarıyla anlat; ChatGPT her ipucuna bir tahmin yapar. Puanın, bildirmek için kullandığın ipucu kelimesi sayısıdır: ne kadar az, o kadar iyi.

Nasıl işler:
- İpucunu kartta yaz. Kart, ChatGPT görmeden önce kontrol eder ve yasaklı bir kelime hangi biçimde olursa olsun kaçtıysa söyler: çoğul ve diğer ekler (kitap, kitabı, kitapçı), birleşik kelimeler, harf harf yazmak ya da diğer dildeki karşılığı.
- Beş ipucu hakkın var. Yasaklı kelime içeren ipucu geçersiz sayılır ve yine bir hak götürür; gizli kelimeyi söyleyen ipucu oyunu bitirir.
- Art arda günlerde bilerek seri yap. Daha fazlasını istediğinde antrenman kelimeleri var.
- Kart, her ipucu için bir kare ve puanını içeren, kelimeyi asla vermeyen bir paylaşım metni verir.

Hesap yoktur: oyunların ChatGPT'nin paylaştığı anonim kimlikle saklanır ve istediğin zaman silebilirsin.
